title: REQ · BootScene.ts has a single SceneObject type import
summary: Only one import type SceneObject line remains in BootScene.ts
description: Context: BootScene.ts lines 12 and 14 both import the SceneObject type from @game/entities/SceneObject. Desired behavior: keep a single import. Expected result: the file has one such import and still uses SceneObject as a type. Why: duplicate imports cause a duplicate identifier compile error.
acceptance_criteria: Given BootScene.ts, when searched for `import type { SceneObject }`, then exactly one match exists
Given BootScene.ts, when compiled, then SceneObject still resolves for the sceneObjects field type
